summary: 29-year-old male climber fell ~90 ft on the Vertigo rappels in Eldorado Canyon State Park; his climbing partner, stuck without a rope, was also rescued; ~3-hour operation with litter evacuation across steep terrain, injured climber transported by ambulance to a medical facility.
location: Vertigo rappels, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Mountain View Fire Rescue; Eldorado Canyon State Park
notes: BCSO case 26-2807; official release published 2026-08-13 (late-reported; one day before nominal freshness window).
